scope: ISA QUANTIZE integration; this is not a whole-model bank allocation
command_bram: separate native command BRAM, not data-bank namespace
permutation: QUANTIZE may assign any three distinct banks to its source/data/scale operands
fp32_layout: four FP32 elements perword, lane0 in bits31:0
int4_layout: 32 signed two-complement nibbles perword, element0 in bits3:0; finalword paddedzero and written with fullbyte strobes
scale_layout: BF16 in bits15:0 of word0, allotherbits zero, fullbyte strobes
row_boundary: Each QUANTIZE traverses from word0. PS manages tiled row residency using explicit DMA instructions.
completion: Data and scale writes must both be accepted before operand validity and ISA completion.
